# telnyx_ai_collections (Data Source)

Lists ai collections, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_ai_collection`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "telnyx_ai_collections" "all" {}

output "collection_slugs" {
  value = [for c in data.telnyx_ai_collections.all.ai_collections : c.slug]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `ai_collections` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ai_collections))

<a id="nestedatt--ai_collections"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ai_collections`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the record type. Always `ai_collection`.
- `settings` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ai_collections--settings))
- `slug` (String)
- `sources` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ai_collections--sources))
- `status` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `uuid` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--ai_collections--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ai_collections.settings`

Read-Only:

- `record_type` (String) Identifies the record type. Always `ai_collection_settings`.
- `retrieval` (Attributes) How documents are retrieved when searching the collection. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ai_collections--settings--retrieval))

<a id="nestedatt--ai_collections--settings--retrieval"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ai_collections.settings.retrieval`

Read-Only:

- `retrieval_type` (String) Retrieval strategy. `vector` runs semantic similarity search; `hybrid` combines vector similarity with keyword matching; `keyword` runs lexical (BM25) matching. `keyword` is not accepted yet: setting it returns 422 `unsupported_retrieval_type`. A collection set to `hybrid` is accepted here but cannot be searched until hybrid execution ships.
- `top_k` (Number) Number of top results to retrieve (1–50).



<a id="nestedatt--ai_collections--sources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ai_collections.sources`

Read-Only:

- `bucket_id` (String) The Telnyx Storage bucket name. Present only for `bucket` sources.
- `collection_id` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the record type. Always `ai_collection_source`.
- `source_type` (String) The type of Telnyx data attached as a source. `bucket` requires an additional `bucket_id`. Only `voice` is searchable today; `meeting_bot`, `message`, and `bucket` attach but are not yet searchable (Coming soon).
- `status` (String)
